payload.reason: The evidence clearly outlines the three layers of the annotation scheme used in the OLID dataset.

claims.text: The three layers of the annotation scheme are: (A) whether language is offensive or not, (B) the type of offensive language, and (C) the target of the offensive language.
Level B categorizes the type of offense into targeted (TIN) and untargeted (INT) insults and threats.
Level C distinguishes between three targets: a group (GRP), an individual (IND), or others (OTH).
